kernel: Koronos native diagnostic kernel plus Debian Linux Live kernel
fallback_loader: Linux Rescue Shell is a separate Linux runtime; not native Koronos Recovery

kernel_policy.live-linux: linux /live/vmlinuz + initrd /live/initrd.img; Init.mp4 plays after Openbox/Aurora startup
kernel_policy.live-safe: linux /live/vmlinuz + initrd /live/initrd.img with nomodeset and SVGA fallbacks
kernel_policy.linux-rescue: linux /live/vmlinuz + initrd /live/initrd.img with chimera.mode=recovery; independent read-only-first Linux rescue
kernel_policy.native-installer: BLOCKED unless /boot/candidates/installer/native-installer-runtime.ready and every dedicated candidate image/manifest exists
kernel_policy.native-recovery: BLOCKED unless /boot/candidates/recovery/native-recovery-runtime.ready and every dedicated candidate image/manifest exists
kernel_policy.koronos-diagnostics: multiboot2 /boot/koronos.elf; early-entry markers are not userspace readiness

artwork_policy.fallback: the ISO synthesizes a 1920x1080 Init.mp4 from embedded wp01/wp02/wp03 if the tracked source asset is empty

handoff: Firmware -> GRUB2 BIOS/UEFI El Torito loader -> Spit Fire menu -> Gates policy menu -> Jasper target menu -> Linux Live/Rescue kernel+initramfs or experimental Koronos Multiboot2 diagnostic ELF

spitfire_artifacts.bios: SF0 512-byte MBR plus assembled SF1/SF2 stage2 and SHA-256 are packaged as experimental raw-disk bootstrap artifacts; not written to the ISO El Torito boot sectors
spitfire_artifacts.uefi: GRUB2 EFI image performs UEFI boot; Spit Fire SF0 is BIOS-only
spitfire_artifacts.menu: GRUB2 Spit Fire menu config hands off to /boot/gates/gates-menu.cfg; Gates hands off to /boot/jasper/live-image.cfg for Linux Live ISOs or /boot/jasper/jasper.cfg for native Koronos ISOs

runtime_candidates.installer: Separate BusyBox/Linux initramfs and installation payload prototype; bootable_by_koronos=false
runtime_candidates.recovery: Separate BusyBox/Linux recovery initramfs prototype; bootable_by_koronos=false
runtime_candidates.activation: No native handoff until acceptance-generated READY sentinels, dedicated native init, filesystem/process services, CPL3/PID readiness and target cold-boot verification all pass

video_policy: GRUB menus can stage/announce Init.mp4 but cannot decode it; Linux-backed targets play it after Openbox is ready. No native Koronos video playback is claimed.
